title: The Concept of Shiv Tattva and Energy Holding Capacity

segments.text: The Concept of Shiv Tattva and Energy Holding Capacity
Introduction: The Illusion of Simply "Getting Energy" (0:00 - 8:00)
Greetings to everyone. Today, we are discussing the concept of Shiv Tattva (the Shiva element). This is a vital topic that needs to be understood deeply.

Often, a person who is constantly falling sick will ask for "energy" or a "power" to heal themselves. While providing energy is entirely possible — we generate immense energy here through constant mantra chanting and yajnas (fire rituals) — simply giving someone energy does not fix the root problem.

If we give someone energy, they might feel completely fine for two days, but by the third day, their energy drops again. They go from healer to healer, constantly seeking energy, only to feel drained again shortly after. The issue is not a lack of availabl e energy; the issue is that the energy is not staying within the body. When a person lacks "holding capacity" ( Grahan Shakti ), the energy poured into them simply drains out the bottom.
What is Shiv Tattva? The Power to Hold (8:00 - 16:00)

This holding capacity is what we call Shiv Tattva . Everyone is born with it, though it comes with certain limitations. When a person takes in too much external energy without the capacity to hold it, their internal holding capacity becomes hollow. Eventually, they don't even feel the energy being given t o them.

Everything in this universe is made of energy. Our connections and relationships with other people are fundamentally built on energy. When your Shiv Tattva (holding capacity) begins to deplete, your energetic connections break down.

As a result, you will slowly become isolated. Your relationships will deteriorate. In extreme cases, your own parents will turn against you, and your spouse or partner will not stay by your side. If you are a man, the woman meant to be by your side will le ave, and vice versa for women. This happens because you simply do not possess the energetic capacity to "hold" them in your life. A person with abundant Shiv Tattva , on the other hand, naturally maintains multiple harmonious relationships because their holding capacity is vast.
Misconceptions About Mantras and Healers (16:00 - 25:00)

When people realize they are isolated and drained, they run to healers or start chanting mantras. But there is a massive misconception: chanting "Om Namah Shivaya" or "Jai Siyaram" generates energy , not necessarily Shiv Tattva .

If you have zero holding capacity, you can generate all the energy you want, but it will still leak out. This is why many healers can successfully heal others but remain perpetually sick themselves. They can access and divert higher energies to their clien ts, but they lack the Shiv Tattva to hold that healing energy within their own bodies. To truly heal and hold energy, one must go to the grass -roots level and build their Shiv Tattva .
The Three Causes of Shiv Tattva Depletion (25:00 - 30:00)
There are three primary reasons a person's Shiv Tattva depletes:

1. Personal Actions: Draining one's own energy through bad habits. 2. Actions of Others: Tantric attacks or negative entities. 3. Divine Deficiencies: A lack of blessings from family deities ( Kul Devta ).
Case 1 & 2: Astral Entities and Tantric Attacks (30:00 - 1:02:00)
When a person depletes their own energy, or when a tantric sends a negative entity (like a Pret ), massive blockages occur.

For example, let's look at a hypothetical person named Ritesh. If Ritesh has good energy but a negative entity attaches to him, that entity might decide to act as his "astral wife." It will fulfill his astrological alignments for a relationship on an astral level. Because that energetic space is occupied, no physical woman will ever enter Ritesh's life. He will remain single and isolated. The entity guards his aura, taking all of his Shiv Tattva . Interestingly, he might become highly successful in his career because he is completely isolated, but his personal relationships will be zero.

In a Tantric attack, a sent entity will often make a "contract" with the family's ancestors (Pitrs ) to get permission to attach to the victim. To successfully drain the victim's Shiv Tattva , a female entity ( Pretni ) is often introduced. The two entities interact, and the victim's Shiv Tattva is siphoned off into the dominant female entity.

Even if the victim starts chanting pure mantras, the dominant entity absorbs that fresh energy and enjoys it. If the victim later goes to a powerful place and has the entity removed and locked away, the entity is gone — but the stolen Shiv Tattva does not return. It is gone forever, leaving the person to move forward in life with a severely diminished holding capacity.
Case 3: Ancestors (Pitrs) vs. Family Deities (Kul Devta) (1:02:00 - 1:13:00)

This is a critical scenario. If a family has the strong blessing of a Kul Devta (Family Deity), their relationships and respect in society will remain intact even if their Shiv Tattva is low. The deity's power protects them.

However, if the family ignores their Kul Devta , the ancestors ( Pitrs ) take the throne. Ancestors, once they leave the physical body, still have worldly desires. To fulfill these desires, they enter the bodies of their descendants — often the women of the household — causing severe physical illnesses and body aches.
Because the ancestors want to maintain their status as the rulers of the house and ensure they keep getting offerings, they start acting like deities. They invite other roaming negative

entities into the home to help "manage" the family's worldly success. The home becomes a guesthouse for negative energies. This continuous energetic exploitation drains the Shiv Tattva of everyone in the family, stripping them of their willpower and vitality until everything runs strictly according to the ancestors' whims.
Conclusion: How to Regain Shiv Tattva (1:13:00 - 1:19:55)
This is deep, root -level knowledge that only comes from a true Guru.

Can you regain Shiv Tattva physically? Yes, to a very small degree. Grounding yourself (walking barefoot on the earth), eating a highly nutritious diet, and building physical strength can increase your Shiv Tattva by a few percentages.

However, if you want to increase your holding capacity in tremendous amounts, it can only come from the astral and divine realms. It requires the grace of higher powers, your Guru, and the deities. You must learn to navigate the astral world, or you will c ontinue to lose your Shiv Tattva to it. Understand this deeply, analyze the events in your life, and hold onto the name of the Divine.
Knowledge Base Q&As: Shiv Tattva and Energy

Q: What exactly is "Shiv Tattva"? A: Shiv Tattva refers to a person's energetic "holding capacity" (Grahan Shakti ). Everyone is born with it, and it determines your ability to retain energy and maintain stable connections and relationships in your life.

Q: Why do I still feel drained shortly after receiving energy from a healer? A: Feeling drained happens when you lack sufficient Shiv Tattva . While an energy session can pour new energy into you, without the internal holding capacity, that energy simply leaks out, leaving you depleted again.

Q: Will chanting mantras like "Om Namah Shivaya" increase my Shiv Tattva? A: No, chanting mantras primarily generates energy . If your holding capacity is already hollow or depleted, the energy generated by chanting will not stay with you. You need Shiv Tattva first to actually hold the energy those mantras create.

Q: Why do some successful healers constantly fall sick themselves? A: Many healers can successfully access and divert higher energies to heal their clients, but they may lack the personal Shiv Tattva to hold that healing energy within their own bodies, leading to chronic illness or personal depletion.
Q: What are the main reasons a person loses their Shiv Tattva? A: There are three primary causes:

1. Depleting your own energy through bad personal habits. 2. The actions of others, such as tantric attacks or negative entity attachments. 3. Divine deficiencies, specifically lacking blessings from your family deities (Kul Devta ).

Q: How do negative entities drain a person's energy? A: A negative entity (like a Pret or Pretni ) can attach to your aura and act as an "astral partner," occupying the energetic space meant for real -world relationships. It siphons off your Shiv Tattva to empower itself, leaving you isolated, single, and energetically empty.

Q: What happens if a family ignores their family deity (Kul Devta)? A: When the family deity is ignored, deceased ancestors (Pitrs ) take control of the household. To maintain their status and fulfill their desires, they often invite other negative entities into the home. This continuous energetic exploitation drains the Shiv Tattva of the living family members, which can cause physical illnesses and broken relationships.

Q: Can I regain my Shiv Tattva through physical habits like diet and exercise? A: Physical habits like grounding (walking barefoot), eating a highly nutritious diet, and building physical strength can increase your Shiv Tattva , but only by a very small percentage.

Q: How can I significantly increase or regain my Shiv Tattva? A: Tremendous increases in holding capacity can only come from higher spiritual realms. It requires the grace of a true Guru, blessings from deities, and learning to properly navigate and protect yourself in the astral world.
